node.title: PMA rate-half core triple-excess reduction
node.statement: Fixing three touched full petals identifies the nonpositive-J rate-half tail with a core RS list of length N=4ell+b-2, dimension K_0=ell+b-1, and agreement m=2ell+b+a-2. Any three contributors force, after removing their common factor, a nonconstant rational map whose 0, 1, and infinity fibers on the core have total size at least 2r+3a. Thus absence of this source-coupled positive three-fiber certificate pays the full tail by 8n per carried source. An exact smooth order-100 arbitrary-core fixture at the first J=0 row shows the generic smooth-core version is false, so the remaining theorem must retain the PMA CRT coupling.
